title: Song Pal  - Clue It Back
style: spoken word intro, industrial electronic, post-punk rhythm section, steel-string fingerpicking, click percussion, analog synth drones, gated snare, vocoder hooks, distorted bassline, sidechain pumping, dry close-mic vocal, tape saturation, 124 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated claps, call-and-response chorus, defiant confession, launch urgency
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Knock on the VDS door, we’re almost there,
Build in layers, breathe in air,
Flow like water, never force attack,
If it feels too loud, we clue it back.

[Pre]
Not one phrase — a hundred forms,
One small line becomes a storm,
From the court to code to midnight track,
Swing it out, then swing it back.

[Chorus]
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me,
Show the clue, hold the groove, turn it to a key,
Flow like water, stay by my side,
We don’t rush the light — we ride.
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me.

[Verse 2]
Pickleball rhythm, golf arc, seesaw line,
Every loop a hook in time,
POV says done, but we know the map,
If it drifts too far, we bring it back.

[Bridge]
Stand by me / stay by my side,
Night gets long but we don’t hide,
One phrase, many variants, same heartbeat track,
You sing your truth — I sing it back.

[Final Chorus]
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me,
Show the clue, hold the groove, turn it to a key,
Flow like water, stay by my side,
No man down tonight — we ride.
Sing it back, swing it back, shape it back to me.
